list.label: Ticker
list.query:

FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_equities/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE regular_trades > 0
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ticker
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_equities/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE regular_trades > 0
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: $ticker daily candles
panels.description: Daily OHLC candles with trade count, one panel per selected ticker.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  first_price::DOUBLE AS open,
  max_price::DOUBLE AS high,
  min_price::DOUBLE AS low,
  last_price::DOUBLE AS close,
  regular_trades AS volume
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_equities/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE ticker = $ticker
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Regular trades per day
panels.description: Regular trades per day for the selected tickers.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, ticker, sum(regular_trades)::BIGINT AS trades
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_equities/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Most traded (latest day in range)
panels.description: Top 20 equities by trade count on the latest day; ignores the ticker filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_equities/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT ticker,
  regular_trades AS trades,
  first_price::DOUBLE AS open,
  max_price::DOUBLE AS high,
  min_price::DOUBLE AS low,
  last_price::DOUBLE AS close,
  (last_price / first_price - 1)::DOUBLE AS intraday_change
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
ORDER BY regular_trades DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Largest intraday moves (latest day in range, 100+ trades)
panels.description: Top 20 intraday moves (last vs first price) on the latest day, 100+ trades only; ignores the ticker filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report_equities/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT ticker,
  regular_trades AS trades,
  first_price::DOUBLE AS open,
  last_price::DOUBLE AS close,
  (last_price / first_price - 1)::DOUBLE AS intraday_change
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
  AND regular_trades >= 100
ORDER BY abs(last_price / first_price - 1) DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20
